SELF-REVIEWED. Category 7 (untrusted content rendering) applied to the changed render path: the new author label can carry an API-sourced companyName and is escaped at the render site via esc(lbl.who); icons are fixed literals. No new findings.

Change was driven by live BETA payload inspection rather than the spec: TSANet posts SYSTEM notes with companyName/creatorEmail null and creatorName 'SYSTEM', which the previous name-equality logic attributed to the partner. Reported upstream as Connect-API-Code#131 along with the companyId request.
Echo suppression now requires a confident attribution and fails open otherwise, so an unidentifiable note is mirrored rather than silently dropped.
Remaining mechanical warning is the known v1-endpoint usage sunsetting 2027-01-01 (#101).
